//: globalPassThroughEnv: Turbo runs in strict env mode, so anything not listed here is STRIPPED before a task starts. Without DATABASE_URL, `DATABASE_URL=… yarn db:migrate` silently migrated whatever apps/mercato/.env pointed at and reported success. These are passed through but deliberately NOT hashed, so overriding a secret or a connection string does not invalidate the build cache. || globalDependencies: the jest entries are load-bearing for `test` caching. Every package's jest.config.cjs spreads jest.config.base.cjs and runs through the shared transformer/resolver, so a change there alters results in EVERY package; without them listed turbo would replay a stale pass for packages whose own files did not change. || tasks.test: `dependsOn: [^build]` is what makes caching this task SAFE, and it is not about build artifacts. Package jest configs map sibling packages to their SOURCE (packages/core maps @open-mercato/shared/* to ../shared/src/*), so a core test can fail because shared/src changed. Turbo hashes a package's own files only; without an edge to the dependency that change would leave core#test on a cached pass and report a false green. ^build pulls each dependency's source into this task's hash, and guarantees packages/core/generated exists before suites that import #generated run. || open-mercato-docs#build: Docusaurus writes build/, not dist/ or .next/, so the generic build task declared no outputs for it and could never restore a cache hit. || open-mercato-docs#test: this suite asserts on build/search-index.json, so it needs its OWN build. The script used to run `yarn clean && yarn build` inline, force-rebuilding the docs site on every CI run and putting it on the unit-test critical path. As a turbo edge it is cached instead. || OM_CHAT_TRANSPORT / OM_CHAT_MATRIX_MODE / OM_MATRIX_*: the app is started through `turbo run start`, so without these the Matrix chat transport can never be switched on — `chat_matrix/di.ts` reads OM_CHAT_TRANSPORT, saw it stripped, returned early, and the deployment ran `local` while every operator-facing signal said `matrix`. Deliberately NOT hashed: a homeserver URL or token is a deployment concern, not a build input. || CI / JEST_MAX_WORKERS / JEST_CACHE_DIR: strict env mode STRIPS anything not listed, so without these three jest.config.base.cjs never sees them — `test:serial` would silently keep using workers instead of running in-band, the CI crash-retry would re-roll the same dice instead of dropping to in-band, and the CI jest cache would be written to a tmpdir that is discarded. Deliberately NOT hashed: changing worker count or cache location must not invalidate a test result. || tasks.typecheck: `dependsOn: [^typecheck]`, deliberately NOT `[^build]`. No .d.ts is emitted anywhere in this repo (build.mjs writes JS only, and packages/shared/dist/index.d.ts does not exist), so every cross-package type resolution goes through the `types` conditions in package.json exports, which point at the sibling's SOURCE. An edge to ^build would force a full build ahead of every typecheck and buy nothing. The edge is still required, for exactly the reason tasks.test needs one: turbo hashes a package's own files only, so a breaking change in packages/shared/src left @open-mercato/core#typecheck on a cached PASS and reported a false green. `turbo run typecheck --dry=json` showed core#typecheck with an empty `dependencies` array before this edge was added.
